source.custom: Backgrounds: feat only, no ASI (2026-11-06 ruling).

system.description:
Student

You were identified as someone with untapped potential at a very young age and were taken in as an apprentice. You were taken from your home to be trained either by the Master who found you. You seldom ever see your biological family, and were raised and educated surrounded by the trappings of the shinobi code taught to you by your master. Now, you have set out into the greater world, seeking to use what you have learned.

Skill Proficiencies: Acrobatics, Choose one Ninshou, Martial Arts, Illusions.

Tool Proficiencies: Forensics Kit

Equipment: A set of Common clothes, a Book full of teachings from your master, 1 Blank Jutsu Scroll, the last Letter you received from your master.

Equipment Pack: Explorer’s or Infiltrator’s Pack (Choose one).

Feature: The Master’s Name

Your master's reputation opens doors within the shinobi community. You can gain an audience with shinobi leaders, village officials, or senior practitioners by invoking your master's name, provided they know who your master is. You retain access to your master's resources — correspondence, libraries, or training facilities — when you can reach them.

Well, learned

Gain a General or Skill feat from Chapter 13 (Recommended: Any Skill Feat)
